today.summary: The Indian stock market opened higher on Monday, with the Sensex rising 200 points and the Nifty crossing 25,850. The biggest news was Tata Steel announcing a plan to buy a 26.38% stake in APL Apollo Tubes for about ₹15,511 crore. This move caused APL Apollo's stock to hit its daily lower limit, meaning it fell by the maximum allowed amount. Meanwhile, IndusInd Bank shares dipped slightly after the bank fired its former CEO and reclaimed his compensation.
